description:
A fast INotifyPropertyChanged source generator for .NET. Eliminates MVVM boilerplate with a single [Notify] attribute, no runtime dependency, full IntelliSense, and debuggable generated code.

Features:
• Auto-generates properties with PropertyChanged notifications
• Built-in equality guards prevent redundant events
• Partial hooks: On{Property}Changing(oldValue, newValue) and On{Property}Changed()
• [NotifyAlso] for dependent properties, child changes, and collection membership
• Reuse existing INPC host invokers without duplicate events or runtime dependencies
• [NotifySetter] for access control (private, protected, internal)
• INotifyPropertyChanging support for undo/redo scenarios
• [NotifyCanExecuteChangedFor] for automatic command refresh
• [NotifySuppressable] for batch notification suppression
• Nested [Notify] class support with generic declaration preservation
• Analyzer diagnostics and code fixes for invalid partial declarations
• Works with WPF, MAUI, Blazor, Avalonia, Uno Platform, WinUI, and Xamarin
• AOT compatible and trimming safe
releaseNotes:
v1.10.0:
• Reuse accessible existing INPC and INPC-changing host invokers without duplicate interfaces, events, or helpers
• Add direct NotifyOnCollectionChanged membership tracking with replacement/null detach handling and target deduplication
• Add NOTIFY013-NOTIFY017 safety diagnostics for incompatible hosts, collection declarations, and invalid generated names

v1.9.0:
• Add explicit target-side [NotifyAlso(NotifyFrom = true)] dependency declarations with transitive graph validation
• Add typed On{Property}Changed(oldValue, newValue) post-change hooks with equality suppression and field/partial-property support

v1.8.0:
• Forward property-targetable field attributes with bound constructor and named values
• Opt into direct child INotifyPropertyChanged notifications with NotifyOnSubPropertyChanged and NOTIFY010 guidance

v1.7.0:
• Generate C# 14/preview partial properties from [Notify] without a runtime dependency
• Support [NotifyAlso] on partial properties and reject ambiguous generated names with NOTIFY009
• Expand transitive [NotifyAlso] dependencies with cycle diagnostics (NOTIFY008)
title: NotifyGen - INotifyPropertyChanged Source Generator
